name: Expert Fieldcraft
summary: Pathfinder Team and Stealth Battlesuits units keep Hidden status even after shooting.

name: Integrated Command Structure
summary: Kroot and Vespid Stingwings can prey-mark a visible enemy for +3" detection range against it; a nearby Ghostkeel or Stealth Battlesuits unit keeps a Kroot/Vespid unit Hidden after it shoots. Exclusive Auxiliaries-tagged detachment.

name: Superior Craftsmanship
summary: Battlesuit Character ranged attacks get +6" range. Exclusive Battlesuit-tagged detachment.

name: Patient Hunter
summary: In battle rounds 3-5, T'au Empire ranged weapons gain Sustained Hits 1; a Guided unit attacking a Spotted target that round also ignores BS and Hit roll modifiers.

name: Hunter’s Instincts
summary: Kroot attacks get +1 to hit under-strength targets, and +1 to wound as well against half-strength targets.

name: Skirmish Fighters
summary: Kroot models gain a 6+ invulnerable save against melee and a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

name: Killing Blow
summary: In battle rounds 1-3, T'au Empire ranged weapons gain Assault; a Guided unit's ranged weapons also gain Lethal Hits that round.

name: Bonded Heroes
summary: T'au Empire Battlesuit ranged attacks within 12" get +1 Strength, plus +1 Armour Penetration as well within 9".
